findings.title: The first binder call repeats whole Catalog/view work after setup and the zero-work counters do not observe it
findings.violatedRelation: T-287 REF-01 lines 206-212 and TASK.002 require established-object reuse, one full unchanged Catalog admission per session, and zero repeated cloning/full admissions/deep-frozen walks after setup. HOW 10.11 X4 and Retained work permit a new full structural pass at first binder sight, weakening that selected bound.
findings.counterexample: After setup creates the owner Catalog/view, their first run-binder use has no retainedResourceMembers entry under the run member schemas. admitResources builds fresh, calls admitContract, then checks isDeeplyFrozen on both original members. admitContract unconditionally calls tree-constructing admitJson before Valibot; the run schemas are full strictObject trees. Their outputs are then discarded in favor of original frozen members. The one logical Catalog owner cache can hit while these full-tree passes still occur.

triage.triggerProbability: Certain on first use of a ready Catalog/view under a previously unused run-binder member schema after setup; subsequent identical members can hit the new cache.
triage.realizedHarm: The selected zero-repeat computational bound is false: complete Catalog/view I-JSON copying, schema traversal/reconstruction and a frozen walk occur after setup. No latency, allocation-byte or RSS magnitude is claimed from static source.
triage.failClosedControls: Canonical admission still runs on that first sight and Product equality/currentness/effect checks remain. This finding is unnecessary work and incomplete proof, not shown unauthorized runtime truth.
triage.causalAssessment: Identity is recovered after the generic gate has already repeated the work, and counters observe selected owner calls rather than all material copying/walking at this seam.
triage.confidence: high for source control flow and counter coverage; operational magnitude indeterminate
triage.blastRadius: First unchanged Catalog/view use for the selected run binder; full selected source path is affected even when later warm calls pass. No claim about all cold reads.
triage.containment: Retain the source as a bounded partial and do not consume the counter zeros as full REF-01 completion. Ordinary invocation behavior can remain usable.
triage.repairComplexity: Bounded existing-owner/binder re-entry; exact implementation effort indeterminate.
triage.regressionRisk: Moderate at the shared binder; widening to a generic schema interpreter or shared admission/immutable redesign would substantially increase risk.
triage.repairRabbitHoleRisk: Avoid general purity proofs, common admission redesign and migration of unrelated consumers.

closureFalsifiers: The first post-setup constructed run call performs any full Catalog/view JSON copy, full structural schema reconstruction, frozen walk, owner admission miss or full canonical comparison.

findings.title: Frozen raw values are recorded and reused as if they were canonical schema outputs
findings.violatedRelation: REQ-P-PUBLIC-CONTRACTS-009/010, Product Live State/Valid Reuse, HOW admission law and X1/X4 require exact request/default/output identity and unchanged raw I-JSON/refusal semantics. counterexamples.entry: Existing defaultedStartCall witness in t287-w2-05-static-binding-algebra.test.mjs:302-339, passed to the new exported internal establishExactDefinitionCall with RUN_OPERATION_CONTRACTS.invoke.start.
counterexamples.causalPath: The witness omits raw fhMode but binds identity to the schema-defaulted request. Ordinary admitExactDefinitionCall returns the normalized invocation, and the existing test expects ownerRequest.fhMode=direct. Establishment checks only non-null admission, discards that returned invocation, freezes and registers call.invocation. Later reuse returns that raw invocation without default application or digest recheck. The receiving owner can get missing fhMode and a raw request body differing from its declared requestDigest.
counterexamples.limit: Normal populateProductRunInvocation explicitly supplies fhMode/rootMode, so this is not a claim that the passing ordinary start fixture already takes this defaulted path.

counterexamples.entry: bindStaticOwner with a valid invocation and strict resource schema whose member is a same-type transform, for example a frozen {n:1} admitted by a member schema returning {n:2}.
counterexamples.causalPath: admitContract produces the transformed value; admitResources ignores output[key] whenever the raw member is deeply frozen and returns/caches {n:1}. On later use it omits that member schema entirely. Likewise reconstructing output only from the supplied member list omits any schema-created default keys.
counterexamples.limit: No transforming production member schema was established in the selected run resource schema. This is a falsifier of the generic binder contract the change now implements, not an allegation that every ordinary run transforms its Catalog.

counterexamples.entry: A resource assertion shell with a required known data property defined non-enumerably, otherwise carrying valid values.
counterexamples.causalPath: admitResources checks that a property is a data descriptor but never checks enumerable=true. Object.fromEntries turns it into an enumerable property before admitContract sees it. The original canonical admitJson explicitly refuses non-enumerable object data properties. The new binder admits the normalized shell instead of preserving that refusal.
counterexamples.limit: CLI JSON cannot express this descriptor. The native/in-process raw boundary can. A frozen rebox retaining an established invocation is recognized by isEstablishedDefinitionCall, so the transport cannot be assumed always to detach/refuse such reboxed resources first.

triage.triggerProbability: Conditional. Standard generated run requests supply the defaults. Raw/defaulted establishment and the generic schema cases are legal entry states of the touched helpers; no observed production incidence is asserted.
triage.realizedHarm: Source-derived counterexamples change receiving-owner request meaning, declared body identity, schema output/defaults or canonical raw refusal. The normal installed fixture does not establish these cases.
triage.failClosedControls: Existing current event-selection, Product semantic, installed-content and effect checks remain. They may contain downstream misuse but do not restore the original normalized input or raw refusal; no ABG authority bypass or corrupt admitted event is demonstrated.
triage.causalAssessment: Both new reuse mechanisms replace an owner-returned admission output with frozen raw input. The resource cache generalizes this substitution over arbitrary member schemas without a law that their output is the original object or that their judgment depends only on that immutable object.
triage.confidence: high for source-derived output/refusal divergences; downstream effect incidence indeterminate
triage.blastRadius: New establishment helper and generic static resource binder. Selected start/default semantics supply a concrete existing witness; other production transforming/currentness-sensitive schemas are not censused.
triage.containment: Keep unaffected ordinary owner checks and existing canonical admission path. Do not grant reuse merely from deep freezing plus schema identity.
triage.repairComplexity: Bounded to construction/normalization and binder resource ownership; no new Product WHAT or library algebra is required.
triage.regressionRisk: Moderate because the generic binder serves multiple owners. Broad callback/purity analysis would be disproportionate.
triage.repairRabbitHoleRisk: Do not add a universal trust registry or a second Valibot interpreter. Keep explicit existing-owner facts and canonical admission/normalization outputs.

adjacentObservations.observation: isEstablishedDefinitionCall records invocation identity, not complete call identity. Object.freeze({...constructedCall}) with the same frozen resources passes, unlike the unfrozen spread in the new test. A frozen resource rebox retaining the invocation can pass too. This falsifies the HOW/test prose that every copied/foreign call detaches. Reuse of exact owned components may be lawful; no separate ABG authority bypass or need for a whole-call registry is inferred. Reconcile the criterion and raw resource falsifier within the same X1/X3/X4 re-entry.
